strata.synthetic_fixture: Clean-room text written for this project. Rights and privacy are settled by construction; external validity is not.
strata.real_source: Two ministry contract templates, held as metadata-redacted derivatives. Their layout and wording are preserved. Author/editor strings are blanked inside the documents; source credits remain in LICENSE.md and acquisition.json. The acquisition record identifies the original download and the stored derivative by separate hashes.

split_policy.note: Assignment is by hand and reproducible from this manifest; no seed is involved. scripts/validate_evaluation_data.py holds the same table and fails on drift. From dataset_version 0.5.0 each retained logical case has exactly one artifact, so the rule that variants of one case share a split no longer has anything to bind; it still holds and would bind again if a variant were restored.
split_policy.holdout_untouched_exception: ED-001 was the one holdout document that had been exposed; see protocol.json holdout_discipline.ed_001_exposure. It is not in the pool from dataset_version 0.5.0, so no exposed document remains in the holdout. The exposure is recorded rather than erased: it happened, and removing the document is not a claim that it did not.

use_constraints: Do not pass this manifest, README, filenames, or research notes to an evaluated arm.
Do not infer expected findings from document construction or source research.

Holdout material is untouched until the final run: no prompt or dial tuning informed by it, no reading of model output on it, no parser change fitted to its phrasing. This rule was breached once, for ED-001; see its holdout_exposure field and split_policy.holdout_untouched_exception. The rule stands and the breach is recorded rather than the rule relaxed.
Do not use these documents as legal templates or legal advice.

mrit-kooperatywy.rights_evidence: The ministry publishes the templates for use and adaptation and permits free re-use of public sector information under source, timing, processing and applicable creator-attribution conditions. The original downloads match the recorded acquisition hashes. LICENSE.md retains the source, original author/editor and company credits, file timestamps, acquisition date and metadata-redaction notice. The credits are transcribed from the published files and preserved in acquisition.json, not inferred authorship roles.
mrit-kooperatywy.rights_decision: Redistribute the two metadata-redacted templates with the attribution in LICENSE.md under the ministry's published re-use conditions. The source credits are retained outside the documents passed to the system; the document-content streams and all recorded evaluation inputs are unchanged.

project-clean-room.rights_evidence: Original text written for this project and dedicated under CC0 1.0; see LICENSE.md.

measurement.what_it_runs: The artefact's own ingestion, segmentation and reference parser. No model call is made and no arm is run.

tokenizer.name: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small
tokenizer.caveat: This was the corpus embedding tokenizer pinned in src/contract_analyzer/corpus.py when the counts below were taken on 2026-08-30. The corpus has since moved to a self-hosted Qwen3-Embedding-4B-4bit-DWQ service and corpus.py no longer pins this tokenizer. It was never the tokenizer of the analysis model. The recorded counts remain reproducible descriptive measurements in this tokenizer only; they are not analysis-model token counts and are not compared with a context-length boundary measured under another model and tokenizer.

environments: Debian bookworm container built from this artefact on 2026-09-02, LibreOffice Writer and tesseract-ocr-pol: all 26 artifacts of dataset_version 0.4.0, which is where the retained five take their recorded values from; these are the recorded values

macOS 15 arm64, project venv, Homebrew tesseract 5.5 with Polish traineddata, no LibreOffice: 22 of those 26; the four .doc artifacts fail loudly with missing_tool: soffice, which includes both retained real-source documents
measurement.cross_environment_agreement: Measured over the 26 artifacts of dataset_version 0.4.0: 21 of the 22 measurable in both environments produced identical values in every field, and RT-010-SCAN differed between tesseract builds. Neither retained real-source document is measurable outside the container, so for dataset_version 0.5.0 the container image pins the recorded values of RT-001-DOC and RT-002-DOC outright.
measurement.revision: Re-measured 2026-09-02 after the deterministic layer changed (protocol 2.1.0): native and OCR PDF reading now emit line breaks between text lines and pages, an outline-numbering marker level (1., 1.1, 2.3.4) was added, monotonicity became a successor rule that also accepts a restart at one, and the structural gate's max/median gap ratio was replaced by a ceiling on the text left after the last marker. The change was designed and checked on development artifacts only; every artifact was then measured once, mechanically, to refresh this block. The previous values were measured 2026-08-30 under dataset_version 0.3.0.

length_description.external_reference_source: Modarressi et al., NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching, PMLR 267:44554-44570 (2025) (Modarressi2025): GPT-4o fell from 99.3% at short input to 69.7% at 32k tokens in that benchmark's no-lexical-overlap task.
length_description.external_reference_limitation: The analysis model, tokenizer and task differ, and the real-source stratum contains explicit statutory citations and therefore lexical overlap. The 32k value is literature context, not this evaluation's boundary and not a classifier for the documents below.
length_description.scope_consequence: The E5 counts describe this pool but do not establish what is short or long for the analysis model. Model-aligned input-token counts are recorded with each measured run. Input length remains a permanent confound of the MID-versus-OFF configuration contrast, not an obligation that can be closed.
length_description.recorded_counts_are_not_re_measured: Every count above is the value measurement recorded for that document on 2026-09-02; nothing was re-measured for dataset_version 0.5.0. Only the selection changed, so the medians are taken over the retained documents and are not comparable with the medians of the earlier pool.
length_description.median_not_reported: dataset_version 0.4.0 reported a median per stratum and combined. From 0.5.0 none is reported: a median over two real and three synthetic documents is not a summary of anything, and reporting one invites a comparison that the selection alone would drive. The 0.4.0 medians were 590 real, 1080.5 synthetic and 1077 combined over 23 cases; the real figure would now read 8510.5 purely because the two short real documents left the pool, while the retained documents are unchanged. logical_case_tokens_recorded_e5 lists every retained count, and at this size that list is the description.
